title: Intelligence report from Port Sainte-Marie in numerical code, enclosed to the Duke of Newcastle, 1729 (Huntington Library mssBLA 191, p. 5)

documents.shelfmark: Huntington Library, Blathwayt papers addenda, mssBLA 191, p. 5 (HDL p15150coll7 61005)
documents.route: El Puerto de Santa María -> 'Cesnok' -> Duke of Newcastle

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaf; deciphered sibling enclosures in the same code are in mssBLA 187, 188 and the letters of 14 July and 4 Aug 1729.

system.summary: Numerical code of three- and four-digit groups, values unknown at the start.

prior_solution.where: Catalogue #826 (checked 28 Oct 2026): no decipherment known for p. 5; sibling letters in the same code carry contemporary interlinear decipherments.

conditions.human_role: Outside contribution: johonn chose the target, set the rules and the plan (rebuild the code from the deciphered sibling enclosures, apply it to p. 5) and approved it; the work was done by Claude Code (Anthropic) under johonn's direction.

solution.what: HDL CONTENTdm API listed the pages of mssBLA 191, 187, 188 and the letters of 14 July and 4 Aug 1729; all 39 page images fetched by IIIF.

Contact sheets of the 39 pages: code pages with a contemporary interlinear decipherment found on 60963, 60916-60920, 60886-60887 and 60907-60909; the interlinear values are syllables and short words, so the system is a syllable-and-word code.

outcome.method_basis: Work in progress: no key obtained yet.

credits.note: Directed Claude Code in rebuilding the code from the deciphered sibling enclosures and applying it to mssBLA 191 p. 5 (catalogue #826).
Interlinear decipherments on the sibling enclosures in mssBLA 187, 188 and the letters of 14 July and 4 Aug 1729 (Huntington Library).
